name: Chill · Death ×3 · Fire
primary:
A projectile flies where you look and strikes the first target. Effects:
• Damage 2 ❤ fire (fire ×0.5 on wet)
• Cold 72: extinguishes and slows, freezes for 4 s at 100 built-up cold (×2.5 on wet); puddles freeze
• Withering: −1 ❤ per second for 9 s
• Life drain: 3.25 ❤ damage, you heal 1.69 ❤
• Heat: sets on fire for 13.5 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
self_description:
